name: Columns
doc: Columns: named columns side by side, one per topic you keep in mind. Each column is a list of foldable panels (notes and windows into threads, Projects, files, web pages); hold a panel's title and drag to reorder, swipe or use the arrows to change column. A panel may take decisions (Dismiss, Comment, Accept at its foot, e.g. a board of suggested tasks): they are kept on the panel and reach the agent as Kanban cards. The agent arranges them through the bar.
